scope: Factual source-to-sink mechanisms used to construct bounded executable abstractions; no vendor source code is redistributed or executed.

records.selected_fact: A schema default_factory value reached generated Python default_factory syntax as a raw expression; the remediation constrains accepted factory expressions.
records.artifact_use: Independent bounded model of raw-expression splicing versus allowlist rejection.

records.selected_fact: OpenAPI-derived text reached PHP double-quoted literals without escaping the dollar interpolation marker; the remediation escapes dollar signs.
records.artifact_use: Independent bounded model of unescaped versus escaped PHP interpolation markers.

records.selected_fact: An OpenAPI const value reached generated TypeScript/JavaScript as an unescaped expression; the remediation serializes the value as data.
records.artifact_use: Independent bounded model of raw expression splicing versus JSON serialization.
